request.summary: Rebuild the Veszprem downtown wayfinding kiosk directly from the supplied VeszpremTerkep.png reference with authored hit targets, explicit routes, and editable destination metadata.
request.audience: Visitors choosing a downtown landmark on a shared landscape touch display in Veszprem.
request.primaryGoal: Let a visitor search or tap a landmark, see its public details, and receive a trustworthy walking route from the configured current location.

assumptions: The supplied 1341x947 PNG is the sole visual and geometric reference for this proof.
The visible red location pin is the representative current position and is exposed as the configurable start id tourinform-veszprem.
The 35 numbered public landmark names are transcribed from the supplied map legend; descriptions, hours, live status, and accessibility are not invented.
Veszprem Arena and Veszprem Sports Swimming Pool are listed by the source but have no downtown route position, so they remain selectable and explicitly off-map.
The accepted surfaces are 1920x1080 and 1366x768 landscape touch displays.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The reference map and touch directory need a landscape kiosk composition; portrait and narrow placements require a separate design.

ownership.rationale: Operators can quick-edit public names, translations, descriptions, categories, hours, and status without rebuilding the app.
The accepted reference artwork and calibrated interaction geometry must remain synchronized.
Explicit reviewed adjacency is application behavior and must not be inferred from editable content.
Operators can adapt the public kiosk copy, start location, reset timing, and distance calibration.
Coordinated presets are safe defaults while Custom exposes the complete surrounding interface palette.
Search and route selection are private to the active kiosk session and clear on reset.

views.purpose: Browse, filter, search, or tap a destination.
Show destination information and the selected route state.
Provide an app-owned multilingual touch keyboard for search.

inputs.action: Select a numbered landmark directly on the map.
Search, filter, select, and reset destinations.
Type in search and activate focused controls.

session.expectation: An active route and search state clear after the configured idle interval or an explicit reset.

rendering.rationale: The map preserves its aspect ratio while the directory reallocates width between the two accepted landscape surfaces.

motion.rationale: A short route draw and detail fade clarify selection; Off shows the final route immediately.

media.fallback: Show a designed map-unavailable state while keeping the destination directory usable.
media.rationale: The supplied illustrated map is the accepted visual source and must work offline.

branding.provenance: The Veszprem identity and illustrated map come from the user-supplied public tourism map.
branding.fallback: Keep the reference artwork unchanged and theme only the surrounding interface.

dynamicText.rationale: The kiosk identity must remain complete at both accepted widths.

dynamicText.rationale: Landmark identity is essential and cannot be truncated in search results.

dynamicText.fallback: Use three lines at the readable minimum and move optional details below the fold.
dynamicText.rationale: The selected destination must remain complete in the detail view.

states.expectation: The complete source map, current-location marker, and directory fill the Full-HD kiosk.
The same map and complete touch workflow remain usable at 1366x768.
The museum route follows the reviewed street and park corridor without crossing building footprints.
The castle route approaches Heroes' Gate through the visible northbound street corridor.
The Auer House route follows Boglyavari Street instead of a direct cross-block shortcut.
The Gyarkert route follows Kossuth and Budapest streets around the large building footprint.
An off-map landmark remains selectable without an invented route.
The on-screen keyboard fits without covering search results or the close action.
The complete custom palette applies to the interface, route, and selection states.
A long title remains complete at the readable floor.
Long landmark names wrap without clipped glyphs or broken touch targets.
Long selected names remain complete in the detail panel.
A bound empty table shows a stable designed state instead of bundled rows.
A direct row array normalizes to the same complete destination directory.
A live table update replaces destination metadata without changing authored map geometry.

behaviors.expectation: Directory and map selection use the same explicit graph and render the same connected route.
Off-map destinations show details without drawing a route.
The configured timeout clears route, selection, query, category, and keyboard state.
The app-owned keyboard enters Hungarian and Latin search text and can be dismissed without losing the query.
A live destination table update replaces content without rebuilding map geometry.

visualDirection.summary: Preserve the warm illustrated Veszprem tourism map as the primary object and surround it with a restrained, touch-first directory that borrows its parchment, teal, gold, and red cues.
signatureChoices: The original map stays fully inspectable rather than becoming a dark dashboard background.
Numbered destination controls and the route line echo the source map's existing visual language.
avoid: Routes that cross buildings or leave the mapped street network

visualReview.intent: A credible visitor-centre map where the source artwork remains legible, landmark selection is immediate, and the route never obscures destination identity.
focus: Verify the packaged source map is sharp and fully visible at both accepted surfaces.
Verify every route line follows the authored graph, endpoint targets align to the numbered landmarks, and off-map locations never receive a route.
Verify the touch keyboard, long names, detail panel, and Light/Dark/Custom palettes remain coherent without clipping.
